text.en:
Honor graduates of four-year or longer courses from schools, colleges and universities of good
standing as determined by the Secretary of Education and Culture are hereby conferred appropriate civil
service eligibilities, as follows:
Second Grade
Civil Service EligibilityFor those who occupy positions requiring the application of knowledge and skill
outside their field of study.
First Grade
Civil Service EligibilityFor those who occupy positions within their respective fields of study.
Honor graduates shall refer to those students who finish their course with at least cum laude

The Civil Service eligibility granted under this Decree shall prescribe in the manner provided
under Sec. 19(9) of P.D. No. 807.

The Civil Service Commission shall promulgate rules and regulations to implement the
provisions of this Decree.

This Decree shall take effect upon its approval provided that Honor graduates from the
schoolyear 1972-1973 and thereafter shall likewise be conferred eligibilities under this Decree.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 11th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
